claim: A 1939 newspaper article title states M.G.M. will not allow actress Hedy Lamarr, who is in row over contract, to work for any other studio.

evidence.quote: The title to the newspaper article states: "Hedy Lamarr Storm Brews, M.G.M. Says It Will Not Allow Actress to Work for Any Other Studio"
Text from newspaper caption: IN FILM SPAT -- Hedy Lamarr, actress, who is in row over contract (Los Angeles Times, 10/4/1939)

notes: UCLA Library record of a Los Angeles Times photograph; secondary (UCLA not in the registry). The caption date 10/4/1939 is ambiguous numerically, so only the year is used.

claim: Actress Hedy Lamarr was at the "Tales of Manhattan" film premiere in Los Angeles, Calif., on August 5, 1942.

evidence.quote: Actress Heddy LaMarr at the "Tales of Manhattan" film premiere in Los Angeles, Calif., 1942

notes: UCLA Library record of a Los Angeles Times news photograph; secondary. The holder spells 'Heddy LaMarr' in the title and links the authority heading 'Lamarr, Hedy, 1913-2000'. August 5, 1942 is the photograph's Date created.

claim: Actress Hedy Lamarr and John Loder were in a courtroom in Los Angeles, Calif., on May 20, 1946, confronting men suspected of robbing their house.

evidence.quote: Actress Hedy LaMarr and John Loder in courtroom, confronting men suspected of robbing their house in Los Angeles, Calif., 1946

notes: UCLA Library record of a Los Angeles Times news photograph; secondary. May 20, 1946 is the photograph's Date created.
